name: AMM Nasir Uddin
contribution: A. M. M. Nasir Uddin became Chief Election Commissioner of Bangladesh on 21 November 2024. As head of the constitutional Election Commission, he led the commission during the preparation and conduct of the 13th Jatiya Sangsad election and the concurrent 2026 referendum.
context: Born in Kutubdia, Cox's Bazar, in 1953, Nasir Uddin studied economics at the University of Chittagong and began his career there as a lecturer in 1977. He joined the Bangladesh Civil Service in 1979 and later served as secretary of the Ministry of Information, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and the Energy and Mineral Resources Division, as well as a member of the Planning Commission.
impact: Nasir Uddin's tenure placed election administration at the centre of Bangladesh's post-2024 institutional transition. He announced the 2026 election timetable, represented the commission in public briefings, and coordinated with political parties, observers, and state institutions. His public statements describe the commission's position; they should not be treated as independent evidence that an election was free, fair, or transparent without reporting and observation data.
highlight: A. M. M. Nasir Uddin has led Bangladesh's Election Commission through the 2026 national election and referendum cycle.
seoTitle: A. M. M. Nasir Uddin: Bangladesh Chief Election Commissioner
seoDescription: Learn about A. M. M. Nasir Uddin, Bangladesh's Chief Election Commissioner since November 2024, and his role in the 2026 election cycle.
shortAnswer: A. M. M. Nasir Uddin is Bangladesh's Chief Election Commissioner, appointed on 21 November 2024 to lead the Election Commission during the 2026 national election cycle.

faq.question: When was A. M. M. Nasir Uddin appointed Chief Election Commissioner?
faq.answer: A. M. M. Nasir Uddin was appointed Chief Election Commissioner of Bangladesh on 21 November 2024 and took the oath with the other commissioners on 24 November.

faq.question: What was Nasir Uddin's role in the 2026 election?
faq.answer: As Chief Election Commissioner, Nasir Uddin led the Election Commission during preparations for and conduct of the 13th Jatiya Sangsad election and the concurrent referendum held in 2026.
